The 0.92 Msun Allende Prieto & Lambert 1999 model mass (HIP 43587) assumes near-solar composition and is adopted only for |[Fe/H]| <= 0.3. It was admitted by a biased Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot [M/H]; the published spectroscopic consensus now adopted for Copernicus is above +0.3 dex. The source row remains in catalog-work/shared-enrichment/literature/fundamental.csv; no replacement mass is inferred.
